_comment: Example seed. Copy to seed.json then: node core/src/trust/seed.js. Principal id `owner`. Identifier assistant-web:owner matches ASMLTR_WEB_OWNER_ID=owner so web chat and asmltr ask are not default-deny. No real Discord snowflakes, names, or emails in git. default_tier is a schema field, not the send gate. Same-guild Discord post is trusted role or resolve() allow; add a discord identifier locally before they can match. Stills/video/code example allowlists live in shared/media-allow.example.json, not here.

principals.notes: Owner of this install. Full trust / bypass_moderation.
Example friend principal. Same-guild Discord post needs a trusted/send grant. Not owner. Add a discord identifier (numeric user id) locally before seeding — leave empty in git.
